races.paceDynamic: Dunkeld Dreamer will take the field along from the front with Secret Force and No Knee Never providing support just behind. With only three confirmed pace angles and a moderate field size, the early tempo should be honest but manageable. The sustained nature of York's 1m4f test will allow the pace to develop gradually through the middle sections. This race shape clearly favours horses with hold-up tactics who can finish strongly, as the front-runners will face a genuine stamina examination over the final three furlongs.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace proves sustainable and the race develops into a stamina test
scenarios.body: The genuine stayers among the hold-up brigade will have every chance to close from off the pace as the front-runners weaken. Prince Of The Seas and Arqoob are perfectly positioned to exploit this tactical setup.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Duo Battle Home
scenarios.trigger: If Dunkeld Dreamer and Secret Force maintain their positions and kick clear
scenarios.body: The younger legs of these forward-running types could prove decisive if they can control the tempo effectively. Their recent form suggests they have the class to sustain their effort to the line.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Mid-Pack Momentum Wins
scenarios.trigger: If No Knee Never and Humble Spark can track the pace without being caught wide
scenarios.body: These prominently-raced types can strike the perfect balance between staying close enough and having something left for a final surge. Their racing weight advantages could prove crucial in the closing stages.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Early
scenarios.trigger: If Dunkeld Dreamer fails to go forward or the early gallop is pedestrian
scenarios.body: A muddling pace would compromise the hold-up horses' finishing kicks and favour those who can position closer. Mayaada's recent win shows she can adapt to different race dynamics.

Monitor Secret Force's early positioning as she needs to be handy to make her prominent style effective
Check how Prince Of The Seas travels turning for home as his finishing kick will determine if the pace has been strong enough
Observe No Knee Never's position entering the straight as her 7lb claim could be decisive if she's in striking distance
Watch for any late market moves on Humble Spark given Jim Goldie's current good form with his runners

races.paceDynamic: Yanifer leads the pace-setting brigade alongside prominent runners Mirabeau, Sujet, Brighton Boy, Lir Speciale, Recency Bias, Extremely Zain, Daydreama and White Crown Star creating a robust early gallop in this competitive handicap. With multiple pace angles engaged, the tempo will be genuine but not suicidal, as no single horse needs to set fractions alone. The large field and 7f trip at York's sweeping track sets up for a sustained drive from the 2f pole where the hold-up horses can unleash their finishing kicks. This race shape strongly favours the hold-up merchants who can sit behind the pace battle and strike late.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Heroes Strike
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent brigade maintain honest fractions without collapsing
scenarios.body: The sustained pace will set up perfectly for the closers to sweep past tiring leaders in the final furlong. Darkness and Akkadian Thunder are proven at this trip with David O'Meara's double-handed assault looking potent.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Pace Sustains
scenarios.trigger: If Extremely Zain or Mirabeau can dictate without pressure
scenarios.body: A classy prominent runner could steal a march by controlling the tempo and having enough left for the finish. William Haggas' Extremely Zain has the class edge being unbeaten this season.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Scenario
scenarios.trigger: If the early leaders go too hard and fold dramatically
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish where mid-division horses benefit from the positional advantage. Sujet and Recency Bias could profit from sitting just behind the speed.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Ambush
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is genuinely strong and the field spreads out
scenarios.body: A longer-priced hold-up horse could emerge from the pack at huge odds. Andesite or Son could benefit from a truly-run race at attractive prices.

races.paceDynamic: Al Qareem holds the clearest early speed and will likely dictate from the front with Epic Poet and Mount Atlas tracking closely behind in the early stages. With only six runners and all showing prominent tendencies, the pace will be solid but controlled rather than frantic, as no genuine speed horses are present to apply early pressure. The lack of dedicated hold-up horses means the tempo will be sustainable through the middle stages before quickening in the final three furlongs. This race shape strongly favours horses with tactical speed who can position prominently and sustain their effort, rather than those needing to come from off the pace.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Controlled Pace Favours Class
scenarios.trigger: If Al Qareem sets steady fractions without early pressure from the field
scenarios.body: The race develops into a test of pure ability rather than tactical positioning, allowing the highest-rated horses to assert their quality in the straight. Mount Atlas and Epic Poet benefit most from this searching examination of stamina and class.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Early Skirmish Suits Stalkers
scenarios.trigger: If Epic Poet or Mount Atlas press Al Qareem early creating a faster tempo
scenarios.body: The increased pace stretches the field and sets up the race for horses tracking in fourth or fifth to strike late. Tabletalk and Gregory benefit from their ability to quicken off a strong gallop.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Al Qareem gets an easy lead and quickens before the field can respond
scenarios.body: Burke's charge capitalises on soft fractions to build an unassailable advantage, with his stamina reserves proving decisive. Al Qareem exploits the lack of early pace pressure while Roaring Legend picks up pieces.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Tactical Battle Favours Experience
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes very steady with multiple horses still in contention turning for home
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish where jockey experience and horse tactical speed matter most. Ryan Moore on Epic Poet and William Buick on Mount Atlas use their positioning skills to maximum effect.

races.paceDynamic: Five Ways appears the sole confirmed front runner in this large field of 22, with the vast majority showing prominent to hold-up styles. This sets up a sustainable early pace as Five Ways won't face immediate pressure, allowing the race to develop into a typical sprint finish where positioning matters enormously. The abundance of prominent runners like Postmodern, Red Spells Danger, Chicago Pope and Man Of Vision will create a packed midfield, while hold-up horses Super Soldier, Boston Dan and First Legion will need significant luck in running. This race shape clearly favours horses that can secure good early positions without needing to lead - prominent runners with tactical speed will have the clearest path to victory.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent runners dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace stays steady with Five Ways uncontested and the prominent brigade get good positions
scenarios.body: The race becomes a positioning battle where horses tracking the leader have first run on the field, with late runners struggling to make ground through the packed field. Hold-up horses find limited racing room as 22 runners compress in the straight.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-up horses find gaps
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent runners get in each other's way or go too fast early chasing Five Ways
scenarios.body: The pace quickens enough to set up the race for closers, with Super Soldier and Boston Dan finding daylight as the early pace collapses. First Legion and Underwriter can also benefit if they get clear runs.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Five Ways wires field
scenarios.trigger: If Five Ways gets an uncontested lead and has enough left in the tank at the business end
scenarios.body: The leader maintains his advantage as the chasing pack fail to organize an effective challenge, with the front runner's class and tactical advantage proving decisive. Late runners again struggle with the large field dynamics.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider benefits from chaos
scenarios.trigger: If the 22-runner field creates significant interference and several fancied runners get blocked
scenarios.body: A horse at longer odds who gets a dream run through or around the field capitalizes on others' misfortune. The sheer size of the field creates opportunities for those who find clear racing room.

races.paceDynamic: Point Of Contact looks the only committed early leader with most others settling prominent or held up, creating a potentially uncontested lead scenario. With Billyb, Grizedale, Empire Of Light and several others content to track, the pace could be quite sustainable early. The lack of genuine pace pressure means Point Of Contact can dictate terms through steady fractions before the field closes late. This race shape strongly favours front runners and prominent racers who can avoid traffic problems, while hold-up horses face the challenge of overcoming a controlled tempo.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Front Running
scenarios.trigger: If Point Of Contact gets an easy lead with no early pressure from the prominent pack.
scenarios.body: Point Of Contact dictates comfortable fractions and has enough left to resist late challenges. The controlled pace means prominent trackers like Empire Of Light and Billyb are best placed to pick up the pieces.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Pace Battle
scenarios.trigger: If Billyb, Empire Of Light and Grizedale all press forward early creating genuine tempo.
scenarios.body: The increased pace stretches the field and sets up a strong finish for closers with tactical speed. Hold-up horses like Fantastic Fox and the improving Pearl Eye can capitalize on the honest gallop.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Late Kick Finish
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely in the middle sections with everyone waiting.
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint from the 2f pole heavily favouring horses with instant acceleration. Prominent racers with finishing kick like Hale End and those dropping back from the pace benefit most.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Surprise Outsider Strike
scenarios.trigger: If the favourites get trapped behind the controlled pace or suffer traffic problems.
scenarios.body: A lesser-fancied runner getting first run and clear passage capitalizes while the market leaders are still finding daylight. Horses like Harswell Ruby or Freddie Steady Go could exploit the tactical nature.

races.paceDynamic: Westmorian is the sole confirmed front-runner in this 22-runner handicap and will dictate terms from the outset without early pressure. With most rivals holding prominent or hold-up styles, Westmorian can establish a comfortable rhythm through the early furlongs before the cavalry charge begins. The large field and single pace-setter creates a classic scenario where the pace builds gradually then intensifies dramatically in the final two furlongs as the prominent runners fan out and hold-up horses attempt their challenges. This race shape strongly favors prominent runners who can track Westmorian closely and kick when the tempo lifts, avoiding both the exposure of leading and the traffic problems that will plague hold-up horses in such a large field.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Westmorian sets a steady pace and prominent runners get ideal tracking positions
scenarios.body: The prominent brigade can measure their efforts perfectly and kick clear when the pace intensifies, leaving hold-up horses with too much to do from the back of this large field. Traffic problems compound issues for those coming from behind.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Hero Finds Gap
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes genuinely strong and hold-up horses find clear runs
scenarios.body: The sustained gallop stretches the field and creates gaps for closers to exploit, with their superior finishing kick proving decisive. Manila Scouse or Yes I'm Mali benefit from their proven ability to weave through traffic.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Scenario
scenarios.trigger: If Westmorian goes too slow and the race becomes a sprint finish
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace creates a bunched field turning for home, leading to a cavalry charge where the best finishing speed wins regardless of position. This favors horses with proven acceleration like Winged Messenger.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Front-Runner Stays Strong
scenarios.trigger: If Westmorian gets his own way completely and finds another gear
scenarios.body: The uncontested leader can dictate fractions perfectly and has enough left to repel late challenges, especially if prominent runners hesitate to commit early enough. Grant Tuer's charge kicks clear in the final furlong.

watchPoints.text: Westmorian's opening fractions will determine the entire race outcome - if he goes too slow early the finish becomes a lottery
Traffic problems inevitable with 22 runners - watch for hold-up horses like Yes I'm Mali and Manila Scouse getting blocked in running
Winged Messenger and Lord Roxby both carry 5lb and 3lb claiming allowances respectively which could prove decisive in tight finish
Kevin Ryan's stable running below par recently with only 4 winners from 37 runners in last 14 days
Several horses stepping back up from 5f to 6f including El Bufalo and Sports Coach - watch for improved performances over more suitable trip
